headings: (220 G) SEA SALT & CEDAR SCENTED CANDLE

jsonld_raw.name: (220 G) SEA SALT & CEDAR SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Sea salt & cedar | A fresh and mineral breeze inspired by the Baltic Sea coast, between salt and pure air. The aromatic and floral heart is reminiscent of open fields and serene nature.
Base of cedar and juniper, with warm nuances that evoke northern forests.

Notes:
Top: bergamot, cucumber, marine notes, mineral
Heart: anise, MUGUET, rose, lavender
Base: amber, musky, cedar wood, juniper
